newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares close mixed in continuous trade.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares close mixed in continuous trade.

text.p: Five stocks rose, four fell and three were flat in 4.1-million-zloty Warsaw bourse continuous trade on Tuesday with the WIG 20 index down 0.1 percent to 1,492.4 points.
The remaining 11 stocks did not trade. NFI units were flat at 138 zlotys in a 20-million-zloty turnover.
Three National Investment Funds (NFIs) fell, one rose and five were flat in a 1.3-million-zloty turnover with the rest not trading in the funds' first continuous session.
